about: Frontier lab announcements, newest first. Curated by hand: every item links to its source. Dates are release/announcement dates; 'YYYY-MM' means only the month is confirmed. Benchmark and pricing facts are as announced by the lab.

items.summary: A model with a context window of up to 1 million tokens.

items.title: Qwen1.5
items.summary: An open family in sizes from small to 72B parameters.

items.title: GLM-4
items.summary: Zhipu's new model, claimed to approach GPT-4, with longer context and multimodal features.

items.title: GPT Store
items.summary: A store for custom GPTs opens to paid ChatGPT users; over 3 million had been created.

items.title: Phi-2
items.summary: A 2.7B small language model that rivals much larger models.

items.title: Mixtral 8x7B
items.summary: An open sparse mixture-of-experts model that outperforms Llama 2 70B on most benchmarks.

items.title: Gemini 1.0
items.summary: Google's first natively multimodal model family: Ultra, Pro and Nano.

items.title: Amazon Q (re:Invent 2023)
items.summary: A generative-AI assistant for work that can be tailored to a business.

items.title: Claude 2.1
items.summary: A 200K-token context window, fewer hallucinations and tool use in beta.

items.title: Board removes Sam Altman
items.summary: OpenAI's board ousts its CEO; he is reinstated on 22 November after employee and investor pressure.

items.title: Bing Chat becomes Copilot
items.summary: Microsoft unifies its assistants under the Copilot name.

items.title: DevDay 2023: GPT-4 Turbo, Assistants API, GPTs
items.summary: A cheaper GPT-4 Turbo with 128K context, the Assistants API, DALL·E 3 and text-to-speech in the API, and custom GPTs.

items.title: Grok (beta)
items.summary: xAI's first chatbot launches in beta for X Premium subscribers.

items.title: DeepSeek Coder
items.summary: DeepSeek's first open model, built for coding.

items.title: Kimi chatbot
items.summary: Moonshot's assistant launches, able to read inputs of up to 200,000 Chinese characters.

items.title: Bedrock generally available
items.summary: Amazon Bedrock opens to all customers.

items.title: Mistral 7B
items.summary: Mistral's first model: a 7B open model under Apache 2.0 that beat larger models.

items.title: Meta Connect 2023: Meta AI assistant and Emu
items.summary: Meta launches its Meta AI assistant (with real-time Bing search), AI characters based on public figures, the Emu image generator, and new Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses.

items.title: Amazon invests up to $4B
items.summary: Amazon becomes Anthropic's primary cloud provider with an investment of up to $4 billion.

items.title: DALL·E 3
items.summary: A new image model built into ChatGPT, much better at following detailed prompts.

items.title: Responsible Scaling Policy
items.summary: Anthropic's framework of AI Safety Levels (ASL) that tie safeguards to model capabilities.

items.title: Claude Pro
items.summary: A paid plan with 5x more usage and priority access.

items.title: Qwen-7B (open source)
items.summary: Alibaba's first open-weight Qwen models.

items.title: Code Llama
items.summary: Llama 2 models specialised for code.

items.title: Llama 2
items.summary: Open models licensed for commercial use, released with Microsoft.

items.title: Claude 2 and claude.ai
items.summary: Better performance, a 100K context window and a public chat website in the US and UK.

items.title: Build 2023: Windows Copilot and plugins
items.summary: Copilot comes to Windows, and Microsoft and OpenAI back a shared plugin standard across ChatGPT and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

items.title: 100K-token context window
items.summary: Claude's context window grows from 9K to 100K tokens — about 75,000 words.

items.title: PaLM 2 (I/O 2023)
items.summary: A new language model with better multilingual, reasoning and coding skills, powering 25 Google products.

items.title: Claude's constitution
items.summary: How Claude's explicit written principles guide its behaviour through Constitutional AI.

items.title: Google DeepMind formed
items.summary: DeepMind and Google Brain merge into a single unit, Google DeepMind.

items.title: Amazon Bedrock and Titan
items.summary: A managed service for building with foundation models from AI21, Anthropic, Stability AI and Amazon's own Titan.

items.title: Tongyi Qianwen
items.summary: Alibaba unveils its large language model and chatbot.

items.title: Segment Anything (SAM)
items.summary: A promptable model that can cut out any object in any image.

items.title: ChatGPT plugins
items.summary: ChatGPT gains plugins, including web browsing and code execution.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot
items.summary: An AI assistant built into Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.

items.title: GPT-4
items.summary: A large multimodal model accepting text and images, a big step in reasoning and exam performance.

items.title: Claude (first public release)
items.summary: Claude and the faster Claude Instant become available through a chat interface and the API.
facts: Early partners included Notion, Quora and DuckDuckGo

items.title: Core views on AI safety
items.summary: Anthropic sets out why it thinks transformative AI may arrive within a decade and how it approaches safety research.

items.title: ChatGPT API (gpt-3.5-turbo)
items.summary: The ChatGPT model opens to developers at $0.002 per 1,000 tokens — ten times cheaper than earlier GPT-3.5 models.

items.title: ChatGLM-6B
items.summary: An open bilingual chat model that developers could fine-tune and run locally.

items.title: LLaMA
items.summary: A family of efficient models released to researchers; its weights soon leaked, kick-starting open-model development.

items.title: Bing Chat
items.summary: A GPT-4-powered chat mode in Bing search.

items.title: Bard
items.summary: Google announces its conversational AI chatbot.

items.title: Google Cloud partnership
items.summary: Anthropic picks Google Cloud as a preferred cloud provider for training and serving its models.

items.title: ChatGPT
items.summary: A free chat interface to a conversational GPT-3.5 model — the fastest-growing consumer app of its time.

items.title: Galactica
items.summary: A science-focused language model whose public demo was pulled within days over fabricated answers.

items.title: Whisper
items.summary: An open-source multilingual speech-recognition and translation model.

items.title: Imagen
items.summary: A text-to-image diffusion model pairing strong language understanding with photorealism.

items.title: Gato
items.summary: A single "generalist agent" transformer that performs about 600 tasks, from captioning to controlling a robot arm.

items.title: OPT-175B
items.summary: Meta releases a 175B-parameter language model, with weights shared with researchers.

items.title: Series B: $580M
items.summary: Anthropic raises $580 million to build infrastructure for studying and improving AI safety.

items.title: DALL·E 2
items.summary: A text-to-image model producing far more realistic, higher-resolution images than the original DALL·E.

items.title: PaLM
items.summary: A 540-billion-parameter language model trained on Google's Pathways system.

items.title: Chinchilla
items.summary: Shows models were undertrained: a 70B model on 4x more data beats the 280B Gopher — compute-optimal scaling.

items.title: AlphaCode
items.summary: An AI system that writes competition code at roughly the level of a median human competitor.

items.title: InstructGPT
items.summary: GPT-3 models fine-tuned with human feedback to follow instructions become the default in the API — the recipe behind ChatGPT.

items.title: Gopher
items.summary: A 280-billion-parameter language model, with studies of scaling, ethics and retrieval.

items.title: GPT-3 API opens without a waitlist
items.summary: Developers in supported countries can sign up for the OpenAI API immediately.
